title: Scalar linearity of ordinary unbounded ringed pro-etale operations
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $u:U\to V$ a morphism of schemes with small pro-etale sites, and $R_U,R_V$ sheaves of commutative rings on those sites, equipped with ring maps $A\to\Gamma(W,R_W)$ for $W=U,V$ (thus giving compatible sectionwise $A$-actions). Suppose the specified coefficient identification $c:u^{-1}R_V\xrightarrow{\sim}R_U$ respects the $A$-algebra structures. Use the ordinary unbounded module derived categories $D(R_W)=D(\operatorname{Mod}(R_W))$ and the canonical adjoint operations $L_u=Lu^*$, $D_u=Ru_*$ of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]. Give these categories the $A$-linear structures induced by their module-sheaf Hom groups and localization [def-weil-linear-category, lem-weil-linear-abelian-derived-category]. Then $L_u$ and $D_u$ are additive $A$-linear functors [def-weil-linear-functor]: for either functor $F$, parallel derived morphisms $s,t$ and $a\in A$, one has $F(s+t)=F(s)+F(t)$ and $F(as)=aF(s)$. No boundedness, completeness or constructibility condition is imposed.

proof.text: By [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations], the coefficient isomorphism makes $P$ exact, and $L_u$ is its termwise induced functor on ordinary unbounded derived categories. Equip both derived categories with the induced structures of [lem-weil-linear-abelian-derived-category]. Exactness supplies preservation of finite limits and finite colimits; step 1 supplies additivity and $A$-linearity. Thus all hypotheses of [lem-cbc-exact-linear-derived-functor] hold for $P$ over $A$, giving $L_u(s+t)=L_u(s)+L_u(t)$ and $L_u(as)=aL_u(s)$.

proof.text: The ordinary unbounded adjunction $L_u\dashv D_u$ is part of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]. Apply [lem-sbc-linear-right-adjoint] to this adjunction and the additive $A$-linearity of $L_u$ from step 2. It gives $D_u(s+t)=D_u(s)+D_u(t)$ and $D_u(as)=aD_u(s)$ on all derived morphisms. Together these are exactly the two functors' asserted linearity [def-weil-linear-functor], in the full ordinary unbounded categories.

lean.statement: theorem proEtaleRingDerivedOperations_scalarLinearity (A : Type v) [CommRing A] {U V : Scheme.{u}} (f : U ⟶ V) (RV : Sheaf (ProEt.topology V) CommRingCat.{u + 1}) (RU : Sheaf (ProEt.topology U) CommRingCat.{u + 1}) (c : (proEtaleSheafInverseImage f CommRingCat.{u + 1}).obj RV ≅ RU) (aV : A →+* RingCat.sectionsSubring (RV.obj ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)) (aU : A →+* RingCat.sectionsSubring (RU.obj ⋙ forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)) (hc : ∀ (a : A) (W : V.ProEt), (proEtaleRingDirectImageMap f RV RU c).hom.app (op W) ((aV a).val (op W)) = (aU a).val (op ((proEtaleBaseChange f).obj W))) : ∃ (lU : Linear A (proEtaleRingModules U RU)) (lV : Linear A (proEtaleRingModules V RV)), (fun [_iU : Linear A (proEtaleRingModules U RU)] [_iV : Linear A (proEtaleRingModules V RV)] ↦ (∀ (M N : proEtaleRingModules U RU) (h : M ⟶ N) (a : A) (W : U.ProEtᵒᵖ) (x : M.val.obj W), (a • h).val.app W x = (aU a).val W • h.val.app W x) ∧ (∀ (M N : proEtaleRingModules V RV) (h : M ⟶ N) (a : A) (W : V.ProEtᵒᵖ) (x : M.val.obj W), (a • h).val.app W x = (aV a).val W • h.val.app W x) ∧ (proEtaleRingDerivedPullback f RV RU c).Additive ∧ Functor.Linear A (proEtaleRingDerivedPullback f RV RU c) ∧ (proEtaleRingDerivedDirectImage f RV RU c).Additive ∧ Functor.Linear A (proEtaleRingDerivedDirectImage f RV RU c)) (_iU := lU) (_iV := lV)
